Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Use our prior context to preserve the precise confidence posture and evidence boundary from that briefing.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Manager communications example card — onboarding-trigger confirmation with Priya", "folder": "manager-communications", "body": "Audience
Priya, in a 1:1; manager-level update before telling Marcus.

What was confirmed
The second cohort cleared for EXP-2023-02-onboarding-trigger. Across two cohorts, pooled week-1 retention was +3.1 percentage points for treatment versus control (p=0.04, n=420). The stabilization cohort held the earlier directional result rather than leaving it as a one-cohort signal. The test was scope-disjoint from the pricing-page experiment: different cohort and metric of record.

My interpretation
Cautiously optimistic. This is past the “maybe noise” phase and strong enough to support a ship plan, but it is not yet fully validated or causal proof. I treated the second cohort as confirmation of a stabilization result—not as permission to overstate certainty. Priya’s response was effectively “good work”; the next communication was to Marcus, with a staged/full-rollout plan conditional on the remaining checks.

Evidence still wanted
- Complete the boring integrity checks: sample-ratio match, signup-source mix, and country/device or other segment skew.
- Check for contamination or distortion from the pricing rollback window, while keeping the experiments analytically separate.
- Read activation completion and support touches as guardrails.
- Observe one more post-ship cohort before becoming more confident or calling the result fully validated.

Boundary to preserve
Say: “The second cohort confirmed a credible, stabilization-level retention lift; I’m cautiously optimistic.”
